_comment: Ed25519 public keys trusted by the Unterm AI-agent runtime. Each entry is baked into the binary at build time; rotating keys means cutting a new Unterm release. Old keys can stay until every active install has upgraded — set `expires_at` so the runtime ignores them automatically after that date.

keys.note: Primary signing key, generated 2026-05-19. Private half lives in alex's macOS Keychain + an offline backup; the on-disk priv file under ~/Documents/unterm-manifests/keys/ should be moved to Keychain after first signing run.
